badges.name: Waterfall Explorer
badges.description: Discover waterfalls and the living things around them.
requirements: Visit a waterfall, creek, or fountain and describe what you hear.
Draw or photograph the water from two different spots.
Name three living things you noticed near the water.

badges.name: Leaf Detective
badges.description: Hunt for leaves and notice their shapes and colors.
requirements: Collect three different safe fallen leaves.
Sort them by size or color.
Make a simple leaf rubbing or tracing.

badges.name: Cloud Watcher
badges.description: Look up and notice how the sky changes.
requirements: Watch the sky for five quiet minutes.
Draw two cloud shapes you saw.
Tell someone whether it felt sunny, windy, or rainy.

badges.name: Sun Print Artist
badges.description: Make art with sunlight, leaves, and imagination.
requirements: Collect three safe leaves or shapes for a sun print.
Make one sun print (or paper version) and wait for it to develop.
Share your artwork with a family member and explain the steps.

badges.name: Color Mixer
badges.description: Mix colors and invent a brand-new shade.
requirements: Mix two colors to make a new one.
Name your new color.
Paint or color a picture using that mix.

badges.name: Animal Observer
badges.description: Quietly notice animals and how they live.
requirements: Watch an animal (pet, bird, or bug) for five quiet minutes.
Write or draw two things it did.
Share one way people can be kind to animals.

badges.name: Bug Buddy
badges.description: Meet tiny creatures with care and curiosity.
requirements: Find a bug outdoors without touching it.
Draw its shape and count its legs if you can see them.
Leave its home the way you found it.

badges.name: Kitchen Scientist
badges.description: Try simple food experiments and notice what changes.
requirements: With an adult, mix two safe ingredients and watch what happens.
Write down one prediction and whether it came true.
Clean your workspace when you finish.
Taste or smell one finished result (if safe) and describe it.

badges.name: Snack Chef
badges.description: Plan and make a simple snack with an adult.
requirements: Choose a snack recipe with an adult.
Wash your hands and prep one ingredient.
Help assemble the snack.
Share it with someone and ask what they liked.

badges.name: Robot Builder
badges.description: Build, pretend, and problem-solve like an engineer.
requirements: Build a robot out of recyclables, blocks, or craft materials.
Give your robot a job it could help with.
Fix one thing that did not work the first time.
Show someone how your robot moves or works.

badges.name: Code Crafter
badges.description: Learn how step-by-step instructions make machines work.
requirements: Write a 5-step instruction for making a sandwich or brushing teeth.
Have someone follow your steps exactly.
Fix one unclear step.
Explain why order matters.

badges.name: Trail Navigator
badges.description: Practice finding your way on a short outdoor walk.
requirements: Take a short walk with an adult and notice three landmarks.
Draw a simple map of where you went.
Explain how you would find your way back.

badges.name: Camp Ready
badges.description: Practice outdoor skills that help you feel prepared.
requirements: Pack a pretend daypack with water, a snack, and a jacket.
Practice sitting quietly outside for three minutes.
Name two Leave No Trace ideas.

badges.name: Elf House Architect
badges.description: Design a tiny outdoor home using found natural materials.
requirements: Sketch a floor plan for a tiny house.
Build it outside using sticks, leaves, or stones (no living plants harmed).
Add one cozy detail (door, path, or roof).
Take a photo and write what an elf might like about it.

badges.name: Shelter Scout
badges.description: Learn what makes a safe, cozy outdoor shelter.
requirements: List three things a good shelter needs.
Build a mini shelter model indoors or outdoors.
Explain how weather would affect your design.

badges.name: First Aid Helper
badges.description: Learn calm, helpful steps for small emergencies.
requirements: Practice washing hands the right way for 20 seconds.
With an adult, pack a tiny first-aid pouch with three useful items.
Role-play calling for help and sharing your location.
Write one safety tip you want your family to remember.

badges.name: Calm Coach
badges.description: Practice staying calm so you can help others.
requirements: Practice three slow breaths.
Role-play comforting a friend with a small scrape.
Write two kind phrases you could say to help.

badges.name: Bridge Builder
badges.description: Test strong shapes and build a mini bridge.
requirements: Build a mini bridge from paper, sticks, or blocks.
Test how much weight it can hold.
Rebuild once to make it stronger.
Explain which shape helped most.

badges.name: Circuit Spark
badges.description: Explore how simple circuits make things light up.
requirements: With an adult, explore a simple circuit kit or a battery flashlight.
Draw a loop that shows power flowing.
Describe one safety rule for batteries and wires.
